evidence: CustomUserDetailsService caches UserDetails instances in-memory with a 5-minute TTL. When UserService.updateProfile was called, the cache entry was not invalidated, serving stale profile details for up to 5 minutes.
impact: Users modifying their target role or name would see outdated attributes in authenticated context queries (/api/auth/me) until TTL expiry.
rootCause: Lack of cache eviction call in UserService.updateProfile.
remediation: Injected CustomUserDetailsService into UserService and triggered userDetailsService.evictUser(email) upon successful profile persistence.
verification: UserServiceTest.testUpdateProfile_Success verified eviction invocation; full Maven test suite passed with 16/16 tests passing.

evidence: Clicking the bookmark button on the Question Details screen only toggled component-local boolean state (saved) without modifying localStorage['intervai_bookmarks'].
impact: Questions bookmarked on the detail screen were not reflected in the Bookmarks view or Question Bank list.
rootCause: Missing integration with localStorage['intervai_bookmarks'] in QuestionDetails.jsx.
remediation: Added localStorage synchronization on mount and an interactive toggleBookmark handler updating intervai_bookmarks.
verification: Frontend build and Vitest suite passed cleanly; verified with vitest and vite build.

evidence: The sort button rendered with text 'Newest first' but had no onClick handler or state hook to toggle sort order.
impact: User interaction with the sorting control did nothing.
rootCause: Unbound presentation button without state handler.
remediation: Added sortOrder state ('desc' / 'asc'), date-based comparator function, and toggle handler.
verification: Verified via npm test and npm run build.

evidence: Regenerate button in Roadmap.jsx submitted hardcoded values ('Software Engineer', 'JavaScript, React') regardless of user profile.
impact: Users preparing for non-SWE roles (e.g., Product Management, Data Engineering) received irrelevant learning roadmaps.
rootCause: Roadmap.jsx did not consume authenticated user data from AuthContext.
remediation: Imported useAuth in Roadmap.jsx and dynamically passed user.targetRole and user.experienceLevel into generateRoadmap.
verification: Verified via npm test and npm run build.
